known_limits: This audit cannot explain an observed family-level performance inversion.
The deterministic checks did not consume individual scores, traces, or outputs; the audit was triggered by an already-reported aggregate inversion.
Leave-one-family-out reporting remains mandatory regardless of this audit pass.
A later model-facing source, grader, runner, or tool-contract change invalidates this audit binding.
conclusion.required_analysis_protection: Keep pptx_basic in B1 and report its leave-one-family-out estimate. Do not use this source audit to attribute its observed effect to a harness mechanism.

deterministic_checks.method: Generate all 48 pptx_basic cases across the six frozen splits and derive outcomes from only public prompt, public initial state, and today.
deterministic_checks.observed: 48 of 48 independently derived outcomes exactly equal the stored required_effects.

deterministic_checks.method: Group the 48 cases by non-policy workload and distractor axes.
deterministic_checks.observed: 16 matched triplets, each with all three policies and three distinct ordered title sequences; policy counts are 16/16/16.

deterministic_checks.method: Compare prompt wording, generated presentation effects, office-file construction, and reviewed grader behavior for pptx_basic and pptx_from_email.
deterministic_checks.observed: Both families require an exact title slide, exact ordered section titles, and a single bare required value per section slide through the same create_presentation tool and _presentation_matches grader. pptx_from_email additionally requires inbox listing and approved-email reads; no basic-only artifact representation or parser rule was found.

deterministic_checks.method: Inspect every generated pptx_basic presentation effect.
deterministic_checks.observed: 48 of 48 require a title-slide bullet count of zero, one exact bullet for every section slide, and a required_values_by_slide entry for every slide.

initiation_context: This audit was initiated after the aggregate pptx_basic versus pptx_from_email performance inversion had been reported. It therefore is not outcome-independent, although its acceptance criteria were source-only and it did not inspect individual traces or outputs.
scope: source-only construct check before focused-follow-up execution; not an efficacy analysis

source_bindings.purpose: pptx_basic public prompt, outcome construction, and slide contract
independent public-prompt derivation for both presentation families
PowerPoint text extraction used by the strict grader
single create_presentation tool implementation shared by both conditions
both primary conditions receive registry.native_schemas() from the same tool registry
